## Summary
The goal was to identify telecom customers likely to churn so the retention team can contact them. Several classification approaches were tried, and an extremely randomized shallow-tree model was delivered as the verified final model.

- Test recall was 0.9324, while test precision was 0.5036.

- No expected score range was available to assess whether the validation performance was unusually high.
